q1.question: When can I pick up my package?
q1.answer: The establishment indicates on the product card the time interval when you can receive your surprise. Usually it's 16:00 - 21:00

q2.question: What's included in the package?
q2.answer:
The package is a surprise. But you know exactly the category: pastries, sandwiches, desserts, lunches, etc.
All packages are formed by the establishment at the end of the day from what they didn't have time to sell, but everything is still fresh and delicious.

q3.question: Is this really not spoiled food?
q3.answer:
No. All dishes in the packages are prepared today, from the same products that go into the regular menu.
It's just that by the end of the day the establishment doesn't have time to sell everything and instead of throwing it away, they offer it to you with a discount.

q4.question: Why such a big discount?
q4.answer:
Because it's better than throwing food away.
The establishment has already spent resources on cooking, and is ready to return at least part of it by offering you a good price.

q5.question: Can I get my money back if I don't like it?
q5.answer:
Returns are possible if there's really something wrong with the package: the food is spoiled or doesn't match the stated category.
In other cases - like in regular cafes - returns are not provided, since the package is already prepared especially for you.
